claims.text: The study examines different variations of the attention-based approach including multi-attention and single attention models.
The models evaluated include LastStateRNN, AvgRNN, AttentionRNN, and MultiAttentionRNN, with the latter incorporating four attention mechanisms for different categories.
The MultiAttentionRNN model, which includes multiple attention mechanisms, achieved the highest performance in the experiments.
